svg.title: Completion changes the cash that must remain protected
svg.desc: Conditional first-payment comparison, USD millions, using the June 30, 2026 reserve of 344.8 as a reference. Completed with credits remaining: minus 82.656, meaning modeled room, not distribution permission. Still constructing, minimum branch only: plus 107.094. Full printed construction formula with zero estimated remaining reserve earnings: plus 315.825. The middle row is a lower bound, not the full formula. Intervening net eligible cash, other support and the actual reserve determination are not supplied; no observed shortage, breach or compliance is established.
